title: Archetype
description: An empirically-defined cEDH archetype for the matchup census (charter: 'Matchup census', 'Archetypes' layer). Built from tournament data first, not a hand-picked commander list.

strategic_architecture.description: Free-text description of the game plan. Two archetypes sharing a commander get separate records only when this materially differs (charter: don't fragment over flex-slot differences).

split_from.description: If this archetype shares a commander with another archetype_id, name it here and justify the split in strategic_architecture.

notable_variance.description: How this list differs from the archetype's modal build, if at all.

policy_ref.description: Pointer to data/policies/<archetype_id>/, null until a policy exists.

confidence_tier.description: Per charter: stratify modeling depth by frequency; rare decks get fewer sims/lower confidence but are not dropped.
